items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: I did Mary Lou. She did Marian McPartland.

ctx.x: I did Mary Lou. She did Marian McPartland. And so she writes all these weird chords so I was just writing a tune this week and I started to really hear those weird chords. So I’m always trying to grow, you know, with the harmony and the rhythm — you know, odd meters and everything.
